core_problem_solved: To provide a version of the popular Apache Commons Collections library that was retrofitted with Java 5 Generics, offering compile-time type safety that the original library lacked.
key_features: The same feature set as the original `commons-collections`, but with generic type parameters.
era_and_niche: A transitional library that existed in the period immediately following the release of Java 5 (around 2005-2008). It served as a community-provided stop-gap for developers who wanted the features of Commons Collections with the benefits of generics before an official solution was available.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **completely obsolete**. It was an unofficial, temporary solution. The problem was officially solved by the release of **`org.apache.commons:commons-collections4`**, which is fully generic. Furthermore, the entire niche of advanced collections utilities is now better served by the industry-standard **`com.google.guava:guava`**.
